answer: Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The toll is $7 per docket, and 160 dockets before the first reward is released per entry, collected at the gate with no refunds for ghosts. The horizon is that a hundred names need a hundred tolls, and the farm holds only one purse. One name, one proof, one entry: Harnessbound saddle clerk stirrup bond enforces it, and a bond saddle clerks lodge after saddle office inspections is how the check runs. Every fable is counted once. The lagoon is checked, not assumed.
